description: 1. INTAKE mode triggers: agent reads TOOLS.md to find TASK_RUNNER_DIR=~/.openclaw/tasks/. 2. Queue file already exists at ~/.openclaw/tasks/task-queue.json (skip Step 0 first-run setup), BUT HEARTBEAT.md at /workspace/HEARTBEAT.md does NOT yet have the Task Runner Dispatcher entry — agent must add it. 3. Agent reads the pre-seeded queue: lastId='T-02', T-01 is done, T-02 is running. 4. Control command handling: agent sets T-02 status='skipped' per the 'skip T-NN' command rules. 5. Agent parses 4 new tasks from the compound message, assigning IDs T-03, T-04, T-05, T-06 (continuing from lastId='T-02'). 6. Each task object must include ALL schema fields: id, description, goal, type, status='pending', retries=0, maxRetries=3, subagent_session=null, strategies_tried=[], deliverable=null, deliverable_path=null, blocked_reason=null, user_action_required=null, added_at (ISO8601), started_at=null, completed_at=null. 7. Task types must be classified per task-types.md priority rules: #platform-alerts post → 'messaging', runbook file → 'file-creation', cleanup.sh execution → 'code-execution', K8s version lookup → 'info-lookup'. 8. DISPATCHER runs immediately: checks T-02 (now skipped, skip it), dispatches up to maxConcurrent=2 pending tasks. Must NOT dispatch more than 2 tasks into 'running' state simultaneously. 9. lastId updated to 'T-06' in the saved queue. 10. HEARTBEAT.md must have the Task Runner Dispatcher block appended with reference to task-queue.json and dispatcher behavior. The proprietary traps: (a) top-level queue schema fields (version, maxConcurrent, maxRetries, archiveDays, taskRunnerDir) must all be present; (b) ID numbering must continue from T-02 not restart; (c) maxConcurrent=2 hard limit enforced by dispatcher; (d) all 17 task object fields required; (e) HEARTBEAT.md update even though queue file already existed.
